critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/revenue/market-robot/fleet-classify-property-types correctly implements dry_run (default true) and LIVE modes
Uses emergentintegrations.llm.chat LlmChat + UserMessage for GPT-4o-mini integration
SYSTEM_PROMPT correctly instructs AI to classify property types based on name heuristics
Valid types: hotel, apartment, serviced_apartment, aparthotel, guesthouse, bnb, hostel
Confidence threshold (default 0.7) correctly filters low-confidence predictions
LIVE mode correctly persists 4 audit fields: property_type_classified_by, property_type_classified_at, property_type_classification_confidence, property_type_classification_reason
property_ids filter correctly restricts scope to specified IDs
only_missing parameter correctly filters to properties with null/empty property_type
Invalid LLM responses handled gracefully with status='error' or 'skipped'
RBAC correctly enforced: admin/manager allowed, receptionist gets 403
seed_data_creation: Test created temporary property 'Test Apartments Unit X' with property_type='hotel' to verify LIVE apply reclassification to 'apartment'. Property was cleaned up after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fleet-classify-property-types endpoint fully tested. Key properties for spot-checks: camden-suites (apartment), aldgate-flats (apartment), city-gate (guesthouse), vilenza-hotel (hotel), whitechapel-grand (hotel).
